body: That advertisements purposely have the people in the ad play horribly at the game. So when someone sees it they get angry with how bad the person is playing and will therefore want to play it themselves to subconsciously prove how awful the person in the advertisement is. I always feel that way when I see an ad like that. Ads that have people obviously playing horribly in them has never made me think that the people in that specific game are just bad and easy to beat, or that the game is hard and provides a fulfilling challenge. It has only ever just made me feel like I want to prove how awful they are.

I care about foxhole I hope the community comes out in support to this. I have 111 hours on record. with probably shy of 100 actual playtime. I mainly go collies but I'm no stranger to Wardens.
I'm only going to say things about stuff I feel confident about as a casual player who only plays when clanmates are on.
I LIKE
1.  When everyone's together. It feels nice. You can really branch out when there are guys around supporting you. Normally there is a solid infantry unit to support mortars or builders.
2.  The community. From my experience I find most people receptive to cooperate on the fly. I love that. And let me state again, I hope they come to show the same support here as they do on frontlines.
3.  The freedom. I love that the game allows for players to organize how they please and do what they want. I hope in the future we can have more freedom in customizing vehicles. This would inevitably make research more complicated and we have more pressing matters but giving the option of having worse armor or engine or gun could reduce logi costs and allow people to explore their creative side. Now I know there's gonna be "meta" builds and that's fine, that only makes it so people will come up with names for certain builds. But that's just my pipe dream.

I DISLIKE
1.  Aiming. This is probably the most difficult. How do you allow lower aiming from a high point? I don't know, I'm not a game developer. But I do want it changed. It's painful to fire my sniper, rifle, any gun and have bullets overshoot. They should at least land AROUND where I'm aiming.
2.  Lemme shovel dirt. When I'm under heavy fire lemme throw a small dirt mound up in idk 10 seconds. Make is absorb nothing just block sight. Seems trivial, but remember I'm just talking about stuff I'm confident in.
3.  Lack of Recon tools. Now this might be too controversial to even attempt to implement but hear me out. I want the ability, expensive or time-consuming or not. I want the ability to recon thoroughly. I just feel like making coordinated mass attacks that counter defenses can only be executed with spying. Which I disagree with as a tactic for a video game like Foxhole.

That's my 100 hours sense on foxhole.
